programme.title: Ek Hi Raasta
programme.desc: Amar and Malti, two orphans, lead a harmonious life with their son, Raja. However, Amar gets murdered and circumstances force Malti to marry Amar's boss, Prakash, which is not accepted by Raja

programme.title: Shalimar
programme.desc: Kumar, a thief, aspires to be mafia boss Sir John's successor by stealing Shalimar, a priceless diamond. Adamant to succeed in his mission, Kumar must overcome many tribulations to seize the diamond.

programme.title: Zameer
programme.desc: Maharaj Singh is a proud owner of several derby-winning stallions. One day dacoits attack his farmhouse with a view of stealing these stallions, but Maharaj fights them, killing the son of the leader.

programme.title: Khubsoorat
programme.desc: The lady of a household runs the place with utmost strictness but hilarity and chaos ensues when her daughter-in-law's younger sister pays a visit and tries to change the rules in the house.

programme.title: Seeta Aur Geeta
programme.desc: Seeta (Hema Malini) is an unhappy heiress who is mistreated by her aunt, Kaushalya (Manorama), who holds the purse strings in the household even though her wealth comes from Seeta's late parents. Despondent, Seeta runs off to end her life, but is rescued and mistaken for her lost twin sister, Geeta (also Malini), who grew up poor and became a tough-minded street performer. The two switch places, surprising those around them by their drastically changed temperaments.
